(program "github.com/synodlang/examples/raftlook"
  (packages "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/random" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft" "std/theme" "std/look" "std/lesson" "std/text" "std/look/basic" "github.com/synodlang/examples/raftlook")
  (package "std/lists" std
    (runs "std/lists"))
  (package "std/math" std
    (runs "std/math"))
  (package "std/net" std
    (runs "std/net"))
  (package "std/random" std
    (runs "std/random"))
  (package "std/sim" std
    (runs "std/sim"))
  (package "std/time" std
    (runs "std/time")
    (phrase "Every"
      (vars (0 d param time) (1 b block))
      (body
        (run-block b#1)
        (after d#0
          (call "time.Every" d#0
            (block
              (run-block b#1)))))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft"
    (uses "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/random" "std/sim" "std/time")
    (runs "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/random" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft")
    (node-fields
      (field Role text exported "follower")
      (field Term number exported 0)
      (field VotedFor node exported (native "sim.nobody"))
      (field Peers list of raft.Node exported (empty list of raft.Node))
      (field votes number 0)
      (field lastHeard time (time 0)))
    (record Elected exported
      (field Term number exported 0))
    (record RequestVote exported
      (field term number 0))
    (record Vote exported
      (field term number 0)
      (field granted bool false))
    (record Heartbeat exported
      (field term number 0))
    (start "start"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 p each raft.Node))
      (body
        (call "raft.WatchElection" (recv n#0))
        (call "time.Every" (time 50000)
          (block
            (if (is (nodefield n#0 raft.Role) "leader")
              (then
                (each _ p#1 (nodefield n#0 raft.Peers)
                  (native "net.send" (message raft.Heartbeat (term (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))) n#0 p#1))))))))
    (phrase "Meet"
      (vars (0 ns param list of raft.Node) (1 n each raft.Node))
      (body
        (each _ n#1 ns#0
          (set-field n#1 raft.Peers (native "lists.without" n#1 ns#0)))))
    (phrase "Majority of" (result number)
      (vars (0 n param number))
      (body
        (result (plus (native "math.floor" (divided-by n#0 2)) 1))))
    (phrase "Leaders" (result list of raft.Node)
      (vars (0 found local list of raft.Node) (1 n each raft.Node))
      (body
        (set found#0 (empty list of raft.Node))
        (each _ n#1 (native "sim.nodesRunning" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft"))
          (if (and (is (nodefield n#1 raft.Role) "leader") (native "sim.isUp" n#1))
            (then
              (set found#0 (native "lists.append" n#1 found#0)))))
        (result found#0)))
    (phrase "LeadersAgree" (result bool)
      (vars (0 terms local list of number) (1 n each raft.Node))
      (body
        (set terms#0 (empty list of number))
        (each _ n#1 (native "sim.nodesRunning" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft"))
          (if (is (nodefield n#1 raft.Role) "leader")
            (then
              (if (in (nodefield n#1 raft.Term) terms#0)
                (then
                  (result false)))
              (set terms#0 (native "lists.append" (nodefield n#1 raft.Term) terms#0)))))
        (result true)))
    (phrase "BecomeFollower"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 t param number))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 raft.Term t#1)
        (set-field n#0 raft.Role "follower")
        (set-field n#0 raft.VotedFor (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "StartElection"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 p each raft.Node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 raft.Role "candidate")
        (set-field n#0 raft.Term (plus (nodefield n#0 raft.Term) 1))
        (set-field n#0 raft.VotedFor n#0)
        (set-field n#0 raft.votes 1)
        (set-field n#0 raft.lastHeard (native "time.now"))
        (each _ p#1 (nodefield n#0 raft.Peers)
          (native "net.send" (message raft.RequestVote (term (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))) n#0 p#1))))
    (phrase "WatchElection"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node))
      (body
        (after (native "random.timeBetween" (time 150000) (time 300000))
          (if (and (is-not (nodefield n#0 raft.Role) "leader") (at-least (minus:time (native "time.now") (nodefield n#0 raft.lastHeard)) (time 150000)))
            (then
              (call "raft.StartElection" (recv n#0))))
          (call "raft.WatchElection" (recv n#0)))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 RequestVote binding raft.RequestVote) (2 candidate binding node) (3 grant local bool))
      (match 0 record raft.RequestVote RequestVote#1)
      (match 1 bind candidate#2)
      (body
        (if (more-than (recfield RequestVote#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))
          (then
            (call "raft.BecomeFollower" (recv n#0) (recfield RequestVote#1 term))))
        (set grant#3 (and (is (recfield RequestVote#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term)) (or (is (nodefield n#0 raft.VotedFor) (native "sim.nobody")) (is (nodefield n#0 raft.VotedFor) candidate#2))))
        (if grant#3
          (then
            (set-field n#0 raft.VotedFor candidate#2)
            (set-field n#0 raft.lastHeard (native "time.now"))))
        (native "net.send" (message raft.Vote (term (nodefield n#0 raft.Term)) (granted grant#3)) n#0 candidate#2)))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 Vote binding raft.Vote) (2 voter binding node))
      (match 0 record raft.Vote Vote#1)
      (match 1 bind voter#2)
      (body
        (if (more-than (recfield Vote#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))
          (then
            (call "raft.BecomeFollower" (recv n#0) (recfield Vote#1 term)))
          (else
            (if (and (and (is (nodefield n#0 raft.Role) "candidate") (recfield Vote#1 granted)) (is (recfield Vote#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term)))
              (then
                (set-field n#0 raft.votes (plus (nodefield n#0 raft.votes) 1))
                (if (is (nodefield n#0 raft.votes) (call "raft.Majority of" (plus (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 raft.Peers)) 1)))
                  (then
                    (set-field n#0 raft.Role "leader")
                    (emit (message raft.Elected (Term (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))) n#0)))))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver raft.Node) (1 Heartbeat binding raft.Heartbeat) (2 leader binding node))
      (match 0 record raft.Heartbeat Heartbeat#1)
      (match 1 bind leader#2)
      (body
        (if (at-least (recfield Heartbeat#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))
          (then
            (if (more-than (recfield Heartbeat#1 term) (nodefield n#0 raft.Term))
              (then
                (call "raft.BecomeFollower" (recv n#0) (recfield Heartbeat#1 term))))
            (set-field n#0 raft.Role "follower")
            (set-field n#0 raft.lastHeard (native "time.now"))))))
    (always "raft/raft.synod:54: always LeadersAgree" (call "raft.LeadersAgree") (slots 0)))
  (package "std/theme" std
    (runs "std/theme")
    (phrase "Paper" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #151A2E)))
    (phrase "Ink" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #EDE9E1)))
    (phrase "Line" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #3A4366)))
    (phrase "Quiet" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #8A90A8)))
    (phrase "Accent" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #F4A340)))
    (phrase "Good" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #5CC8B8)))
    (phrase "Warning" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #E8C35A)))
    (phrase "Critical" (result color)
      (vars)
      (body
        (result #E86F5A))))
  (package "std/look" std
    (uses "std/sim" "std/theme")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/theme" "std/look")
    (phrase "Card for" (result shape)
      (vars (0 n param node) (1 box draw shape) (2 name draw shape))
      (body
        (draw (native "look.rect" 96 56) box#1)
        (native "look.fill" box#1 (call "theme.Ink"))
        (draw (native "look.label" (native "sim.name" n#0)) name#2)
        (native "look.fill" name#2 (call "theme.Paper"))
        (result (native "look.group" (list box#1 name#2)))))
    (phrase "Travel … from … to … over"
      (vars (0 s param shape) (1 a param shape) (2 b param shape) (3 d param time))
      (body
        (native "look.tween" "x" s#0 a#1 (time 0))
        (native "look.tween" "y" s#0 a#1 (time 0))
        (native "look.tween" "x" s#0 b#2 d#3)
        (native "look.tween" "y" s#0 b#2 d#3)))
    (phrase "Remove"
      (vars (0 s param shape))
      (body
        (call "look.Fade … to" s#0 0)
        (after (time 300000)
          (native "look.delete" s#0))))
    (phrase "Fade … to"
      (vars (0 s param shape) (1 o param number))
      (body
        (native "look.tween" "opacity" s#0 o#1 (time 300000))))
    (phrase "Pulse"
      (vars (0 s param shape))
      (body
        (native "look.tween" "scale" s#0 1.15 (time 150000))
        (after (time 150000)
          (native "look.tween" "scale" s#0 1 (time 150000))))))
  (package "std/lesson" std
    (uses "std/sim")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson")
    (record Asked exported
      (field Question text exported ""))
    (record Noted exported
      (field Text text exported ""))
    (phrase "Ask"
      (vars (0 q param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0)) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Note"
      (vars (0 t param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Noted (Text t#0)) (native "sim.nobody")))))
  (package "std/text" std
    (runs "std/text"))
  (package "std/look/basic" std
    (uses "std/lesson" "std/lists" "std/look" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text" "std/theme")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson" "std/lists" "std/theme" "std/look" "std/net" "std/text" "std/look/basic")
    (when-trace "sim.started"
      (vars (0 border draw shape))
      (body
        (native "look.layout" "ring")
        (draw (native "look.rect" 1592 992) border#0 (for "border" "border"))
        (native "look.stroke" border#0 (call "theme.Critical"))
        (native "look.tween" "opacity" border#0 0 (time 0))))
    (when-trace "sim.added"
      (vars (0 n binding node) (1 card draw shape) (2 above local shape) (3 i each number) (4 line each text) (5 row draw shape))
      (match 0 bind n#0)
      (body
        (draw (call "look.Card for" n#0) card#1 (for "card" n#0))
        (set above#2 card#1)
        (each i#3 line#4 (native "sim.stateRows" n#0)
          (draw (native "look.label" line#4) row#5 (for "row" (native "text.join" (list (native "sim.name" n#0) "/" (native "text.from" (plus i#3 1)))))
            (reactive
              (native "look.tween" "text" row#5 (item (native "sim.stateRows" n#0) i#3) (time 300000))))
          (native "look.placeBelow" row#5 above#2)
          (set above#2 row#5))))
    (when-trace "sim.crashed"
      (vars (0 n binding node))
      (match 0 bind n#0)
      (body
        (native "look.fill" (attached "card" n#0) (call "theme.Quiet"))))
    (when-trace "sim.restarted"
      (vars (0 n binding node))
      (match 0 bind n#0)
      (body
        (native "look.fill" (attached "card" n#0) (call "theme.Ink"))))
    (when-trace "sim.removed"
      (vars (0 n binding node) (1 i each number))
      (match 0 bind n#0)
      (body
        (call "look.Remove" (attached "card" n#0))
        (each _ i#1 (native "lists.range" 1 (native "lists.size" (native "sim.stateRows" n#0)))
          (call "look.Remove" (attached "row" (native "text.join" (list (native "sim.name" n#0) "/" (native "text.from" i#1))))))))
    (when-trace "net.sent"
      (vars (0 m binding msg) (1 a binding node) (2 b binding node) (3 ball draw shape) (4 tag draw shape) (5 dot draw shape))
      (match 0 bind m#0)
      (match 1 bind a#1)
      (match 2 bind b#2)
      (body
        (draw (native "look.circle" 6) ball#3)
        (native "look.fill" ball#3 (call "theme.Accent"))
        (draw (native "look.label" (native "net.type" m#0)) tag#4)
        (native "look.placeAbove" tag#4 ball#3)
        (draw (native "look.group" (list ball#3 tag#4)) dot#5 (for "dot" (native "net.id" m#0)))
        (native "look.flight" dot#5 (attached "card" a#1) (attached "card" b#2) m#0)))
    (when-trace "net.arrived"
      (vars (0 m binding msg) (1 a binding node) (2 b binding node))
      (match 0 bind m#0)
      (match 1 bind a#1)
      (match 2 bind b#2)
      (body
        (call "look.Remove" (attached "dot" (native "net.id" m#0)))))
    (when-trace "net.dropped"
      (vars (0 m binding msg) (1 a binding node) (2 b binding node) (3 r binding text))
      (match 0 bind m#0)
      (match 1 bind a#1)
      (match 2 bind b#2)
      (match 3 bind r#3)
      (body
        (call "look.Remove" (attached "dot" (native "net.id" m#0)))))
    (when-trace "sim.broken"
      (vars (0 rule binding text))
      (match 0 bind rule#0)
      (body
        (call "look.Fade … to" (attached "border" "border") 1)
        (native "look.effect" "glow" (attached "border" "border"))
        (after (time 900000)
          (call "look.Fade … to" (attached "border" "border") 0))))
    (when-trace "sim.emitted"
      (vars (0 lesson.Noted binding lesson.Noted) (1 origin binding node) (2 caption draw shape))
      (match 0 record lesson.Noted lesson.Noted#0)
      (match 1 bind origin#1)
      (body
        (draw (native "look.label" (recfield lesson.Noted#0 Text)) caption#2 (for "caption" "caption"))
        (native "look.tween" "y" caption#2 930 (time 0)))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/raftlook"
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft" "std/look" "std/look/basic" "std/sim" "std/theme")
    (runs "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/random" "std/sim" "std/time" "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft" "std/theme" "std/look" "std/lesson" "std/text" "std/look/basic" "github.com/synodlang/examples/raftlook")
    (phrase "RoleColor" (result color)
      (vars (0 r param text))
      (body
        (if (is r#0 "leader")
          (then
            (result (call "theme.Accent"))))
        (if (is r#0 "candidate")
          (then
            (result (call "theme.Warning"))))
        (result (call "theme.Ink"))))
    (when-trace "sim.added"
      (vars (0 n binding raft.Node) (1 card draw shape))
      (match 0 node "github.com/synodlang/examples/raft" n#0)
      (body
        (draw (call "look.Card for" n#0) card#1 (for "card" n#0)
          (reactive
            (native "look.fill" card#1 (call "raftlook.RoleColor" (nodefield n#0 raft.Role)))))))
    (when-trace "sim.emitted"
      (vars (0 raft.Elected binding raft.Elected) (1 n binding node))
      (match 0 record raft.Elected raft.Elected#0)
      (match 1 bind n#1)
      (body
        (call "look.Pulse" (attached "card" n#1))
        (native "look.effect" "glow" (attached "card" n#1))))))
